question: What outcomes result from rites performed without proper qualification in this life and beyond?
premises: Rites are performed for fruit in this world and the next
Improper rites fail to yield that fruit
They still involve bodily hardship and loss of wealth
inference: There is no fruit here or hereafter, only bodily torment and loss of wealth.
plain_english: There is no fruit here or hereafter, only bodily torment and loss of wealth.
